$comment: Acceptance fixture for any model that wants to claim VSON-X-extractor support. Each entry references an image bundled with the studio. Same images as vson-extractor — graph topology should match modulo the single SpatialFact-edge collapse documented in docs/vson-x-semantics.md §4.4. A model passes if at least ceil(0.8 x 4) = 4 of the 4 envelopes conform on first try. The image the Talmy gate was pinned to was withdrawn on 2026-08-04 (spec/CHANGELOG.md); talmy_directional below records where that requirement is still decided.

talmy_directional.$comment: The Talmy gate was pinned to one demo image, and that image is gone. What it decided was never image-specific and is not lost: C5 requires exactly one vso:viewer on every directional SpatialFact, vss:DirectionalNeedsViewerShape enforces it, so any envelope counted above that carried a directional fact without a viewer would fail SHACL and not conform. The case is exercised on every push by the corpus `make x-skill-check` actually runs.
